requirement.description: The get_domain_separator function in eip712.py is not correctly implementing the EIP-712 domain separator calculation, causing test failures in test_get_domain_separator. The function doesn't properly handle all required fields or the packing of domain values.
requirement.contract: Implement the EIP-712 domain separator calculation according to the standard specification. The function should: 1. Properly calculate the type hash for the EIP712Domain type 2. Correctly pack the domain values (name, version, chainId, verifyingContract) with proper formatting 3. Return the correct keccak256 hash of the packed domain data 4. Handle all domain fields properly including string conversion and hex formatting

requirement.description: The transaction signing process is failing with "cannot rlp encode items of type " errors because transaction fields are not being properly handled when they are None values.
requirement.contract: Modify the transaction signing and serialization functions to properly handle None values in transaction data: 1. Filter out None values before RLP encoding 2. Ensure all required fields are present and properly formatted 3. Handle missing fields gracefully without breaking the signing process 4. Validate transaction data before attempting to serialize it

requirement.description: The sign_text_message function is not correctly handling text message signing for personal_sign mode, which is causing test failures in test_sign_text_message.
requirement.contract: Implement proper text message signing for both eth_sign and personal_sign modes: 1. Correctly format the message with the Ethereum signed message prefix for personal_sign 2. Generate the correct keccak256 hash of the message 3. Sign the message hash with the private key 4. Return the proper VRS signature tuple
